property_summary: For every caller, settle() may succeed at most once per locked guess: after settle() the guess must be consumed so a repeated settle() call by the same actor always reverts; the mutant never clears guesses[msg.sender].block, so a second settle() by the same actor succeeds (executing the draw logic again).
change_summary: Delete the statement `guesses[msg.sender].block = 0;` so the guess is never cleared.
